$changed=@(); $notes=@(); $rt=Get-AzRouteTable -ResourceGroupName {resourceGroup} -Name '{vnetName}-rt-blackhole' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if(-not $rt){ $rt=New-AzRouteTable -ResourceGroupName {resourceGroup} -Name '{vnetName}-rt-blackhole' -Location $loc; $changed+='created route table {vnetName}-rt-blackhole' }; if(-not @($rt.Routes | Where-Object { $_.AddressPrefix -eq '0.0.0.0/0' -and $_.NextHopType -eq 'None' }).Count){ $null=($rt | Add-AzRouteConfig -Name 'blackhole-internet' -AddressPrefix '0.0.0.0/0' -NextHopType None | Set-AzRouteTable); $rt=Get-AzRouteTable -ResourceGroupName {resourceGroup} -Name '{vnetName}-rt-blackhole'; $changed+='added 0.0.0.0/0->None blackhole route' }; foreach($sn in $vnet.Subnets){ if($sn.Name -match $platform){ continue }; $nsg=$null; if($sn.NetworkSecurityGroup){ $nsgName=($sn.NetworkSecurityGroup.Id -split '/')[-1]; $nsg=Get-AzNetworkSecurityGroup -ResourceGroupName {resourceGroup} -Name $nsgName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; if(-not $nsg){ $nsgName='{vnetName}-nsg-'+$sn.Name; $nsg=Get-AzNetworkSecurityGroup -ResourceGroupName {resourceGroup} -Name $nsgName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if(-not $nsg){ $nsg=New-AzNetworkSecurityGroup -ResourceGroupName {resourceGroup} -Name $nsgName -Location $loc; $changed+="created NSG $nsgName" } }; $want=@(@{n='Allow-VNet-Inbound';p=4000;d='Inbound';a='Allow';s='VirtualNetwork';t='VirtualNetwork'},@{n='Allow-VNet-Outbound';p=4000;d='Outbound';a='Allow';s='VirtualNetwork';t='VirtualNetwork'},@{n='Deny-All-Inbound';p=4096;d='Inbound';a='Deny';s='*';t='*'},@{n='Deny-All-Outbound';p=4096;d='Outbound';a='Deny';s='*';t='*'}); $dirty=$false; foreach($r in $want){ if(-not @($nsg.SecurityRules | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq $r.n }).Count){ $p=$r.p; if($r.a -eq 'Deny'){ while(@($nsg.SecurityRules | Where-Object { $_.Direction -eq $r.d -and $_.Priority -eq $p }).Count){ $p-- } } else { while(@($nsg.SecurityRules | Where-Object { $_.Direction -eq $r.d -and $_.Priority -eq $p }).Count){ $p++ } }; $null=($nsg | Add-AzNetworkSecurityRuleConfig -Name $r.n -Priority $p -Direction $r.d -Access $r.a -Protocol '*' -SourceAddressPrefix $r.s -SourcePortRange '*' -DestinationAddressPrefix $r.t -DestinationPortRange '*'); $dirty=$true; $changed+="$($nsg.Name): rule $($r.n)@$p" } }; if($dirty){ $nsg=($nsg | Set-AzNetworkSecurityGroup) }; if(-not $sn.NetworkSecurityGroup -or $sn.NetworkSecurityGroup.Id -ne $nsg.Id){ $sn.NetworkSecurityGroup=$nsg; $changed+="$($sn.Name): NSG attached" }; if(-not $sn.RouteTable -or $sn.RouteTable.Id -ne $rt.Id){ $sn.RouteTable=$rt; $changed+="$($sn.Name): blackhole route table attached" }; if($sn.PrivateEndpointNetworkPolicies -ne 'Enabled'){ if(@($sn.PrivateEndpoints).Count){ $notes+="$($sn.Name): privateEndpointNetworkPolicies left Disabled (Azure refuses enabling on a subnet already holding private endpoints - documented residual)" } else { $sn.PrivateEndpointNetworkPolicies='Enabled'; $changed+="$($sn.Name): privateEndpointNetworkPolicies Enabled" } } }; if($changed.Count){ $null=($vnet | Set-AzVirtualNetwork) }; $noteText=''; if($notes.Count){ $noteText=" [notes: $($notes -join '; ')]" }; if($changed.Count){ "deny-by-default baseline applied to '{vnetName}': $($changed -join '; ')$noteText" } else { "'{vnetName}' already carries the deny-by-default baseline - no change$noteText" }
